product.title: Full Day Tour to Machu Picchu From Cusco

description.text: In Cusco, this full-day Machu Picchu outing includes a pre-departure briefing, transport to the Ollantaytambo station, round-trip train tickets, citadel admission, and the bus between Aguas Calientes and Machu Picchu. The published format is private for the booked group, with snacks listed and water left as an extra. The calendar day runs about 14 to 15 hours because the rail and bus connections fill the window. The day is built for visitors who want a guided citadel window without assembling train, bus, and ticket pieces independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on Ollantaytambo, Aguas Calientes, and Machu Picchu that define this train day rather than a two-day Sacred Valley overnight or a city-ruins half day.
